$description: SEARCH FIELD size — radius follows global form/input radius (Paragon default is 0). Header catalog sizes match pll.harvard.edu (.catalog-search).

border-radius.$description: Header catalog search input radius (PLL .form-text computed) → --pgn-size-search-field-header-input-border-radius

padding-y.$description: Header catalog search vertical pad (PLL padding 14px 20px) → --pgn-size-search-field-header-input-padding-y

padding-x.$description: Header catalog search horizontal pad / placeholder inset (PLL) → --pgn-size-search-field-header-input-padding-x

padding-left.$description: Alias of padding-x for SCSS that only sets left → --pgn-size-search-field-header-input-padding-left

size.$description: Header catalog search submit hit area (PLL .form-submit) → --pgn-size-search-field-header-icon-size

glyph.$description: Header catalog search glyph size (PLL .icon-search::before font-size) → --pgn-size-search-field-header-icon-glyph
